All 5 vendors have replied. Committed lead times in days (blank means not quoted):
- RM-001: V01 12, V02 18.
- RM-002: V01 12, V03 10, V05 21.
- RM-003: V01 15, V02 18.
- RM-004: V01 15, V02 18.
- RM-005: V02 18, V05 21.
- RM-006: V01 12, V02 18.
- RM-007: V01 15 (only quote).
- RM-008: V03 21, V05 21, V04 56.
- RM-009: V02 30, V04 70.
- RM-010: V02 30, V04 70.

Most products supported: V01 Kovai Finechem quoted 6 of 10 lines, and V02 Tungabhadra quoted 7. V01 passed the questionnaire on all 6 of its lines. V02 passed on 5 of 7.

V02 has a risk-flag problem. It carries CLAIM_CONTRADICTED and WITHHELD flags on 7 rows, so wide coverage there comes with risk.

Closest to spec: V01 is the strongest. It ranks #1 on 5 SKUs, has 5 comparable rows, and averages 13.5 days lead time. Its only flag is one NEED_DENSITY. V04 Lumen ranks #1 on 2 SKUs. However, V04 quoted only 3 lines, at 56–70 days lead time. All 3 are flagged LATE, so it does not look likely to meet the 20 December 2026 need-by date. V03 is strong on RM-002, where its 10 days is the fastest quote. It has an expired CoA and a strength adjustment on its other line. V05 passed the questionnaire on none of its 3 lines.

Caveats: the 6 rows with no comparable flag were left out of cost comparisons. I did not check each spec line by line. "In line with spec" here rests on questionnaire clearance, risk flags and rank.
